typicalChallenges: Are security-relevant events (authentication failures, privilege escalation, data access) captured in logs?
How long are logs retained and are they tamper-proof for forensic purposes?
Is there correlation between application logs and security monitoring to detect advanced threats?
How is access to monitoring data itself controlled to prevent information disclosure?
Are SLIs and SLOs defined and are they being measured and reported?
What is the on-call burden and are alerts actionable with clear runbooks?
How will you distinguish between application issues and infrastructure issues during incidents?
What is the mean time to detect (MTTD) and mean time to resolve (MTTR) for incidents?
How will developers debug issues in production without direct access to production systems?
Is observability instrumentation part of the definition of done for new features?
How are deployment-related issues detected and correlated with specific releases?
What observability tooling is available in development and testing environments?
What are the costs of log storage, metrics collection, and tracing at projected data volumes?
How do observability costs scale as the service grows and generates more telemetry?
What is the cost of the monitoring platform versus the cost of undetected incidents?
Are there opportunities to reduce observability costs through sampling or tiered retention?
